name: commission-statement
title: Commission statement
for_each: select po.id, y.name || ' ' || p.name as name from comm.payouts po join comm.payees y on y.id = po.payee_id join comm.periods p on p.id = po.period_id where not p.imported order by p.starts_on, y.name

sections.title: Summary
sections.sql: select y.name as payee, p.name as period, po.currency, po.quota_cents, po.credited_cents, po.commission_cents, po.adjustments_cents, po.total_cents from comm.payouts po join comm.payees y on y.id = po.payee_id join comm.periods p on p.id = po.period_id where po.id = $1

sections.title: How it was worked out
sections.note: Every credited deal, each quota band and its rate, and every adjustment. Frozen when the period locked.
sections.sql: select l.kind as line, l.label as detail, l.basis_cents, l.rate_pct as rate, l.amount_cents, po.currency from comm.payout_lines l join comm.payouts po on po.id = l.payout_id where l.payout_id = $1 order by l.position

sections.title: Super or KiwiSaver on this payment
sections.sql: select y.country, y.employment, y.retirement_rate_pct as rate, po.super_due_cents, po.super_paid_on, po.currency from comm.payouts po join comm.payees y on y.id = po.payee_id where po.id = $1

name: plan-letter
title: Commission plan letter
for_each: select a.id, y.name || ' ' || pl.name as name from comm.assignments a join comm.payees y on y.id = a.payee_id join comm.plans pl on pl.id = a.plan_id where a.ends_on is null or a.ends_on >= current_date order by y.name

sections.title: Your plan
sections.sql: select y.name as payee, pl.name as plan, a.monthly_quota_cents as monthly_quota_cents, y.currency, a.starts_on, coalesce(a.ends_on::text, 'until replaced') as ends_on, pl.clawback_days || ' days' as clawback_window from comm.assignments a join comm.payees y on y.id = a.payee_id join comm.plans pl on pl.id = a.plan_id where a.id = $1

sections.title: Rates by quota band
sections.note: Each band pays its rate on the part of your credited sales that falls inside it.
sections.sql: select trim_scale(t.floor_pct) || '% to ' || coalesce(trim_scale(t.ceiling_pct) || '%', 'no limit') as band, t.rate_pct as rate from comm.assignments a join comm.plan_tiers t on t.plan_id = a.plan_id where a.id = $1 order by t.floor_pct

sections.title: Acceptance
sections.note: Sign and return. Commission is paid against the plan you have accepted.
sections.sql: select coalesce(a.accepted_on::text, 'Not yet accepted') as accepted_on, coalesce(a.acceptance_evidence, '') as evidence from comm.assignments a where a.id = $1
